detail.longDescription:
Okay, it's happening. Loombre 1.0 beta goes out later today. Tomorrow if something catches fire that isn't the logo.

Installers for all four platforms, including Intel Macs. But I want to be upfront about the Intel Mac build, because I'd rather tell you now than have you find out at 11pm when something won't work.

Here's the deal: I don't have an Intel Mac. I only have Apple Silicon Macs to test on. The Intel build exists, it compiles, it packages, and that's about all I can vouch for. I don't know if hardware transcoding works or if the installer behaves on older macOS. I've never run it on an actual Intel Mac.

Whether I can keep supporting Intel Macs after 1.0 depends a lot on whether anyone uses it and whether I can find a way to test it. I'm not pulling support. I'm just not making promises I can't keep.

So if you've got one of these machines sitting around and enjoy being the first through the door, I would love your help. Same if you're on any of the other platforms and want to kick the tires before this goes final. Tell me what broke. Also give me a backhanded compliment like "it actually works so far". I like those.

Reports go to the GitHub repo. Include your platform, hardware, what you were doing, and what happened. Copy and paste any error messages if any. I should have an issue template ready by then.

And if you're just now hearing about this: Loombre is a self-hosted media server for people who are tired of their media server phoning home. No telemetry. No account required. No cloud dependency. The code is all there if you want a look: [github.com/loombre](https://github.com/loombre)

#selfhosted #mediaserver #opensource #foss
